payout_value_note: Flat $100 to the referring member and $100 to the new member. No limit on unique referrals.
payout_quote: when they open a new checking account or loan, you'll both receive $100! ... There is no limit to the number of unique account referrals a member can make.
steps: Member refers a friend, family member, neighbor, or co-worker to Fitzsimons Credit Union (complete the online referral form).
Friend opens a new checking account (with at least 5 transactions) or a loan within 90 days of starting membership.
Friend must not have had a previous relationship with Fitzsimons Credit Union.
Both members must be in good standing at the time of bonus distribution.
$100 bonus deposited into each savings account as a dividend bonus after 90 days.
catches: No limit on unique referrals — but promotion EXPIRES 09/30/2026.
Checking account needs at least 5 transactions (or a loan) for both members to qualify.
Bonus deposited after 90 days; the CU may reclaim the bonus if the account is closed within 6 months of opening.
Cannot be combined with any other offer; offer can be revoked at any time.
Membership regional: Adams, Arapahoe, or Denver County.
biggest_catch: No referral cap, but the promo expires 09/30/2026 — and the CU can reclaim the bonus if the account closes within 6 months.
eligibility: Fitzsimons CU membership (lives/works/worships/attends school in Adams, Arapahoe, or Denver County); new member must be new to Fitzsimons.
timing: Online referral form ~5 min active; $100 each deposited after 90 days.
